events.text: You are the Baron (minion): Setup: there are two more outsiders than usual.
You are the Imp (demon): Each night except the first: picks a player, who dies. If this player kills themself, a minion becomes the demon.
You are the Chef (townsfolk): First night: learns how many pairs of evil players sit next to each other.
You are the Fortune Teller (townsfolk): Each night: picks two players and learns whether either is the demon. One good player, chosen at setup, registers as the demon to this role only.

You are the Mayor (townsfolk): If only three players are alive and no execution happens that day, good wins. If the demon would kill this player at night, the Storyteller may kill another player instead.
You are the Butler (outsider): Each night picks a master; may vote only when the master votes.
You are the Soldier (townsfolk): Cannot be killed by the demon.
Night 1 falls.
The demon is Bram.

events.question: Which 3 good roles not in play is the demon shown?
events.reason: Three roles the town will not expect, so the demon has room to move.

events.text: Your minion is Odette. Good roles not in play, to bluff with: Ravenkeeper, Washerwoman, Slayer.
